content.comment_body: Hello, I need help with my assignment. I have two temperature measurements (temp1 and temp2) using sensors with ranges from -30 to 60 °C and 0 to 10V output. I want to convert the difference between T1 and T2, which I can calculate with a math instruction, but I am unable to convert the resulting values from "-2000" to "+2000" to a 0-10V output. How can I map this range to the analog output?

To solve this, first add 2000 to your calculated value using a math function. This transforms the range from 0 to 4000. Make sure you perform this addition within the same math block, since [product_name] cannot process negative values outside math operations. After you have your value between 0 and 4000, divide it by 400 to scale it to a range of 0 to 10 for your output signal.
